description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TopNavAdapter used for rendering a horizontal top navigation bar in an Android TV application. It manages focus handling, rendering of a special search item, and stabilizes item widths to prevent layout shifts when focus changes. The class includes diffing logic, caching of text measurement for layout consistency, and custom focus and key event handling.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter.TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class that manages individual navigation tab views, handles binding data, focus changes, and key events.

methods.name: measureAndCacheWidth
methods.description: Measures the width of a label in normal and bold styles to ensure consistent item widths on focus.

methods.name: getCachedWidthFor
methods.description: Retrieves a cached width for a given label to avoid re-measuring.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a data item (label or search icon) to the view holder and sets up focus, click, and key event handling.
